reuse.why: Changes only the existing getRangeAmount and getApproxAmount helpers, still using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance, so every consumer via getPlannedAmount picks up the rule.

duplication.why: No logic is added outside the two shared definitions; the change is two one-line bodies.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules where the planned-amount helpers live.

scope.why: Only the two helper bodies, their comments and their tests change.

maintainability.why: The rule is now simpler (min / minus threshold) and defined exactly once.
